scope: All ten EP1 production CG families; both portrait and landscape variants are governed by the same wardrobe facts.

wardrobe.continuityNote: Arrival/travel baseline; establish Nika's own relaxed-elegant identity before she meets Matteo.

nika.outfit: Dusty-blue cotton blouse with rolled cuffs, warm taupe high-waisted wide-leg trousers, soft sand leather belt and brown practical crossbody bag.
nika.silhouette: relaxed tailored travel separates with a clean feminine line

sharedSceneDistinctness.silhouetteContrast: Nika is readable as a modern professional traveller.

dualFormatVerification.portrait: Keep face, suitcase and gate readable above the dialogue-safe lower area.
dualFormatVerification.landscape: Use the horizontal space for the gate, sea depth and full suitcase without making Nika a small figure.

families.reworkReason: Current baseline is too close to Matteo's pale linen register and lacks a distinct arrival look.

wardrobe.continuityNote: Same morning gate look continues from S01; Matteo enters in a darker structured host look so the two silhouettes separate immediately.

nika.outfit: Same dusty-blue blouse, taupe trousers and practical bag as S01; sleeves remain lightly rolled for an early work arrival.

matteo.outfit: Deep olive structured overshirt over a charcoal fine-gauge knit, stone trousers and dark brown leather belt.
matteo.silhouette: structured mature host silhouette with stronger shoulders

sharedSceneDistinctness.paletteContrast: dusty blue/taupe Nika against deep olive/charcoal Matteo
sharedSceneDistinctness.silhouetteContrast: soft relaxed separates against structured overshirt and mature shoulder line

dualFormatVerification.portrait: Keep faces, handshake, keys, folder and gate readable above the mobile dialogue layer.
dualFormatVerification.landscape: Use the wide entrance court and respectful gap while keeping handshake, keys and folder at readable scale.

families.reworkReason: Primary Nika/Matteo wardrobe collision in a shared scene.

wardrobe.continuityNote: Continuous morning walk from the gate into the villa; retain the gate outfits, but remove the suitcase from the active gesture and let the architecture carry the transition.

nika.outfit: Same dusty-blue blouse, taupe trousers, small jewellery and leather bag; blouse cuffs remain rolled.

matteo.outfit: Same deep olive structured overshirt, charcoal knit, stone trousers and dark belt as the gate.

sharedSceneDistinctness.silhouetteContrast: relaxed separates against structured host layers

dualFormatVerification.portrait: Keep guiding gesture, faces and old-stone interior visible.
dualFormatVerification.landscape: Use arches, stair and wall photographs as a villa anchor without widening into an empty establishing shot.

families.reworkReason: The continuous scene must preserve a deliberate, distinct pair rather than two pale linen silhouettes.

wardrobe.continuityNote: Same first-day base outfit for Nika, adapted for a hot working kitchen with sleeves rolled and bag set aside; Elio changes into a clearly professional kitchen uniform.

nika.outfit: Dusty-blue blouse with sleeves rolled to the forearm, warm taupe trousers and small gold jewellery; leather bag is set on a bench, not worn during the kitchen action.

elio.outfit: White chef jacket under a clean white apron, sleeves rolled, dark olive work trousers and practical kitchen shoes.
elio.silhouette: light active kitchen-worker silhouette distinct from both Nika and Matteo

sharedSceneDistinctness.paletteContrast: dusty blue/taupe Nika against white/dark-olive Elio
sharedSceneDistinctness.silhouetteContrast: soft office-travel separates against active chef uniform

dualFormatVerification.portrait: Keep white apron, upright knife, cookware, faces and cup visible above the dialogue layer.
dualFormatVerification.landscape: Use the wide kitchen station and steel surfaces to make the knife unequivocally culinary, preserve eye-line and keep the lower worktop dialogue-safe.
invariants: cookware and non-threatening professional context in both

families.reworkReason: Keep the confirmed Elio semantic fix while separating Nika from the pale linen register and making the kitchen action explicit.

nika.outfit: Muted taupe sleeveless knit top under a washed-olive lightweight blazer, charcoal-taupe trousers and slim leather watch.
nika.silhouette: clean professional work silhouette with softer tailoring

matteo.outfit: Charcoal structured overshirt-jacket over a tobacco knit, stone trousers and dark brown belt/watch.
matteo.silhouette: controlled office-owner structure, clearly heavier and darker than Nika

sharedSceneDistinctness.paletteContrast: washed olive/taupe Nika against charcoal/tobacco Matteo
sharedSceneDistinctness.silhouetteContrast: soft tailored blazer against structured overshirt-jacket

dualFormatVerification.portrait: Keep hands, faces, table edge, keys and closed folder above the mobile dialogue layer.
dualFormatVerification.landscape: Use opposite sides of the work table and shutter light; preserve practical office intimacy and readable props without invented document text.

families.reworkReason: Current office family repeats the same light-linen language and fails the professional-context change.

wardrobe.continuityNote: Same afternoon work look as the office, adapted with rolled sleeves and a practical service layer; Giulia and Elio establish the staff-world costume code.

nika.outfit: Washed-olive utility overshirt over an ivory tee, taupe trousers, rolled sleeves and leather watch.
nika.silhouette: practical service-visit layer over relaxed professional base

giulia.outfit: Cream blouse under a warm terracotta housekeeping apron, charcoal skirt and sensible low shoes.

elio.outfit: Cream staff shirt under a dark olive work apron, sleeves rolled and practical trousers.
elio.silhouette: active background staff silhouette, distinct from Giulia and Nika

nika.outfit: Dusty-blue chambray overshirt over an ivory tee, sand trousers, brown belt and practical crossbody bag.
nika.silhouette: open outdoor overshirt with relaxed walking movement

elio.outfit: Dark tobacco-olive overshirt over a rolled cream shirt, dark trousers and worn practical shoes; no apron off duty on the harbor walk.
elio.silhouette: warm civilian waterfront silhouette, visibly different from Nika's airy overshirt

sharedSceneDistinctness.paletteContrast: dusty blue/ivory Nika against tobacco/olive Elio
sharedSceneDistinctness.silhouetteContrast: open walking overshirt against compact civilian outdoor overshirt

dualFormatVerification.portrait: Keep empty cup, faces and harbour waterline visible above dialogue; Elio remains in civilian outdoor layers.
dualFormatVerification.landscape: Use stone promenade, boats and seaweed-weather atmosphere while keeping the conversational pair at readable scale; no staff apron in either format.

families.reworkReason: Harbor scene needs an outdoor/social-context variation instead of the same villa work uniform.

nika.outfit: Muted navy lightweight jacket over a dusty-blue knit top, muted taupe trousers, thin chain and brown shoulder bag.
nika.silhouette: quiet evening layer with restrained modern line

leo.outfit: Charcoal architectural field jacket over a faded rust knit, dark trousers and weathered brown boots.

acceptance: A family is complete only when its portrait and landscape rework both pass mechanical integrity, wardrobe continuity validation and independent visual acceptance.
